Data engineer with 4 years of experience building batch and streaming
pipelines on Spark and Flink. Cares about data contracts, cost efficiency,
and making datasets trustworthy enough that analysts stop keeping their own
shadow copies.

Data Engineer — Meridian Commerce (2022–present)
- Own the order-events pipeline: Kafka -> Flink -> Iceberg on S3, ~1.2B
 events/day, exactly-once semantics via two-phase commit sinks.
- Led adoption of data contracts (Protobuf schemas + CI compatibility
 checks) between the checkout team and analytics; breaking-change
 incidents dropped from monthly to zero over two quarters.
- Rebuilt the nightly batch layer from Hive on EMR to Spark on EKS with
 spot instances and Iceberg table maintenance, cutting compute cost 38%.
- Built dbt models and freshness/volume anomaly checks for the core

Analytics Engineer — Southbridge Fintech (2020–2022)
- Owned the dbt project (300+ models); introduced staging/mart layering,
 CI with slim builds, and documentation coverage checks.
- Migrated reporting from a read replica to Snowflake; modeled slowly
 changing dimensions for account status history.

Data Analyst Intern — Civic Data Collective (2019)
- Cleaned and published open civic datasets; first exposure to the gap
 between "data exists" and "data is usable".

Python, SQL, Scala (basic), Spark, Flink, Kafka, dbt, Snowflake, Iceberg,
Airflow, Dagster, AWS (S3, EMR, EKS, Glue), Protobuf, Great Expectations,
data contracts, dimensional modeling, cost optimization.
